This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]]''' was a patron of [[Quarek'k]], a large bar complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Shadows" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Shistavanen along with his companions&mdash;an [[Unidentified Utai patron|Utai]] and a [[Unidentified Zabrak patron|Zabrak]]&mdash;were drinking in the Quarek'k when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] came in during a mission. The three of them blocked Sing's path and the Zabrak tried to elicit a kiss from Sing, which resulted in the Zabrak's arm being cauterized by Sing's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Shistavanen lunged at Sing with his [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] and ended up being decapitated.<ref name="Shadows" />
